name: Babylon's Dream
source:
Pleasure in Babylon! 🏛️❤️🔥 You're rich, you live in a city overflowing with abundance, and you have three gorgeous concubines 💰👑 Will more women arrive to complete your harem? 😏 Enjoy this visual novel!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5249170/Babylons_Dream/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在巴比伦纵享欢愉！🏛️❤️🔥你腰缠万贯，居住在一座富庶繁华的城邦，坐拥三位国色天香的姬妾💰👑还会有更多美人投怀送抱、充实你的后宫吗？😏尽情享受这部视觉小说吧！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5249170/Babylons_Dream/]Steam[/url]]
